close_reason: Added query_nested_under_not_related_ids_without_related_type_returns_invalid_arguments test covering the NOT operator branch. The rustdoc 'AND/OR/NOT operator nodes recurse' claim now has a fixture per branch. cargo test --all-features clean (45 unit tests now).
description:
metadata.rs:569: comment says 'AND/OR/NOT operator nodes recurse into their conditions'. There is a test (metadata.rs:1237) that uses OR. There is no test using NOT — the easy test would be:

  filter: { operator: "NOT", conditions: [{ relatedIds: ["EM1"] }] }

…and asserting invalidArguments. The NOT path through the recursion is identical to the OR/AND path (it iterates op.conditions), but the absence of test coverage on the NOT branch is a documentation hole — the comment claims coverage that doesn't exist.

What would make it clear: either add a test that covers NOT, or remove 'NOT' from the comment and limit the claim to AND/OR.
title: walk_filter_for_related_ids_constraint comment says 'AND/OR/NOT operator nodes recurse' but only AND and OR tested — NOT branch has no coverage
